units.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for TypeScript reads, writes, and manipulates PDF files in Node.js. It parses a PDF into an in-memory object model on Open and serializes a fresh, renumbered document on Save. It supports page edits, metadata changes, reordering, appending revisions incrementally, and digital signing. The library converts PDF to HTML, Markdown, DOCX, EPUB, SVG, and image formats, and it renders Word documents into PDF.

It parses PDF content streams with parseContentStream and serializes them back with serializeContentStream, and it repairs damaged files using Document.recovery and Document.Repair while validating structure with Document.Validate and Validate.

It manipulates pages with Document.AddPage, Document.InsertPage, Document.RemovePage, Document.Reorder, Document.Split, Document.ExtractPages, Document.Append, and Document.Merge, and it operates on Page objects directly.
It adds text with Page.AddText and Page.AddTextBlock, supports FontFamily and EmbeddedFont, and controls paragraph flow with FlowParagraphOptions.
It draws images with Page.AddImage, embeds SVG objects with Page.AddSVGObject, and uses Page.Graphics and PageGraphics for vector drawing, including TilingPattern.
It adds interactive elements with Page.AddCheckbox, Page.AddComboBox, Page.AddTextField, Page.AddLink, and Page.AddStamp, and it handles Form and Annotation objects.

It creates and manages logical structure with Document.CreateStructTree, Document.GetStructTree, and StructTreeRoot, tags content with Document.AutoTag, and validates or converts to PDF/UA with Document.ValidatePdfUa and Document.ConvertToPdfUa.

It secures documents with EncryptOptions and PubSecEncryptOptions, signs them with Document.Sign, adds validation data with Document.AddValidationData, and converts to or validates PDF/A with Document.ConvertToPdfA and Document.ValidatePdfA, while redacting or sanitizing content with RedactOptions and SanitizeOptions.

It exports documents to HTML, Markdown, DOCX, and EPUB with Document.ToHtml, Document.ToMarkdown, Document.ToDocx, and Document.ToEpub, and renders pages to SVG and image formats with Page.ToSvg and Page.ToImage.

Aspose.PDF FOSS for TypeScript provides the Document class as the primary entry point for working with PDF documents. It supports opening, creating, and manipulating PDF content through a set of methods that operate on pages, fonts, forms, and other document elements.

The Document class provides methods to open existing PDF files, create new documents, manage pages through operations such as adding, inserting, removing, reordering, splitting, extracting, appending, and merging pages, and saving the result.
The Document class supports adding fonts to a document by loading them from bytes or files, loading fonts by name or family, and working with FontFamily and EmbeddedFont objects.

The Document class provides form handling capabilities through the Form object, which supports adding various form fields such as checkboxes, combo boxes, list boxes, push buttons, radio groups, signature fields, and text fields, checking field values, and enforcing form rules.

The Document class supports digital signing and certification of PDF documents through methods that add signatures, certify documents, add validation data and document timestamps, and verify existing signatures and timestamps using options such as EncryptOptions, PubSecEncryptOptions, ExternalSigner, Signer, SignOptions, and SignatureReport.

The Document class provides validation and conversion capabilities for PDF/A, PDF/UA, and PDF/X standards through methods such as Validate, Repair, recovery, ValidatePdfA, ValidatePdfUa, ValidatePdfX, ConvertToPdfA, ConvertToPdfUa, ConvertToPdfX, and ValidationDataOptions.
The Document class supports structural tree operations for tagged PDF documents through methods such as GetStructTree, AutoTag, CreateStructTree, and StructTreeRoot.
The Document class provides table extraction capabilities through the GetTables method, which works with Page and PagePath objects to identify tables in a document.
The Document class supports conversion to various formats including HTML, Markdown, DOCX, and EPUB, as well as page-level conversion to SVG and image formats using ImageOptions.
The Document class provides document sanitization capabilities through the Sanitize method using RedactOptions to remove sensitive content.
The Document class supports layer management through the FlattenLayers method and OptionalContent handling.
The Document class provides XMP metadata handling through methods such as GetXmp, SetXmp, GetXmpValue, SetXmpValue, and SyncMetadata.

The Document class supports attachment and collection management through methods such as GetAttachments, AddAttachment, RemoveAttachment, GetCollection, SetCollection, and RemoveCollection using Attachment objects.

Aspose.PDF FOSS for TypeScript reads and writes PDF documents, converts them to SVG, HTML, Markdown, and DOCX, and supports form filling, annotation, and digital signing. It targets Node.js applications running on >=22 and is version 0.1.0.

LoadLimits bounds memory and object counts for Document.Open and related operations, but it does not bound CPU time or combined memory across structures, and Process documents you did not write in a separate process with an operating system memory and time limit — ResourceLimitError is thrown when a bound is reached.

Document.recovery scans damaged files for object headers and recovers objects stored in /ObjStm containers, but an encrypted document that lost its trailer also lost /ID, which RC4 and AES-128 hash into the file key, so those are refused with an error naming /ID, and ObjStmDamage records what each container recovered and why.

Page.ToSvg emits text as positioned elements styled by font family and weight, so exact glyph shapes depend on the viewer's fonts, and SvgOptions controls whether annotations and form-field appearances composite; JPXDecode and JBIG2Decode decode but render as gray placeholders.

FlowParagraphOptions and FlowHeadingOptions configure text added via Flow.AddMarkdown, but complex-text shaping is opt-in for embedded fonts, Standard-14 fonts do not shape, and text is shaped as-is with no Unicode normalization — supply input in NFC form for best results.

Flow.AddDocx maps WordprocessingML onto the same flow engine AddHtml and AddMarkdown use, so a document reflows with no page break between pages, and DocxFlowResult reports skipped items such as headers, footers, comments, and internal hyperlinks rather than drawing them.

Document.Sign produces CMS or PAdES signatures with optional DocMDP permissions and RFC 3161 timestamps, and SaveOptions and SignOptions control encryption, appearance, and incremental appending, but incremental-append requires the in-memory model to be unchanged since Open.
AddBarcodeOptions configures the appearance and placement of a barcode added to a PDF page.
AddDocxResult reports the outcome of adding content from a DOCX file to a PDF document.
AddImageOptions specifies how an image is positioned, scaled, and rendered when added to a PDF page.
AddImagePagesOptions controls the layout and appearance of one or more images inserted as new pages.
AddImagePagesResult provides details about the pages created when inserting images as pages.
AltTextFigure represents an alt-text entry for a figure element in a tagged PDF structure.
AltTextOptions defines settings for generating and embedding alt-text in a PDF document.
AltTextReport summarizes the alt-text generation process and any issues encountered.
AnnotData holds the raw data of an annotation object extracted from a PDF document.
AskExcerpt represents a snippet of text returned in response to a natural-language query.
AskOptions configures the behavior of natural-language queries against a PDF document.
AskResult encapsulates the response from a natural-language query, including excerpts and metadata.
BarcodeModel describes the detected barcode, including its type, value, and bounding box.
BorderStyle defines the width, color, and dash pattern used for drawing borders around elements.
ChainOptions specifies how multiple operations are combined into a single processing chain.
ChainResult aggregates the outcomes of all operations executed in a processing chain.
CollectionFieldDef describes a field definition used when building a collection of documents.
CollectionSettings controls how multiple documents are merged into a single collection.
ColorConvertReport documents the color conversion process and any skipped or modified colors.
ColorImageResult provides details about an image after color processing, including dimensions and format.
ColorSkipped indicates a color that was not converted during a color processing operation.
CompareTextOptions configures how text content is compared between two documents.
ComparisonHtmlOptions controls the format and styling of HTML output produced by a document comparison.
ComparisonJsonOptions specifies the structure and content of JSON output from a document comparison.
ComparisonReportOptions defines the level of detail and format for a document comparison report.
ContentOp represents a single operator and its operands parsed from a PDF content stream.
ContentVisitor provides a callback-based interface for traversing and processing PDF content stream operators.
ConvertCategory classifies the type of conversion being performed, such as PDF to image or PDF to DOCX.
ConvertColorsOptions specifies how colors in a PDF document should be transformed during conversion.
ConvertOptions controls the behavior and output format of a document conversion operation.
Crl represents a certificate revocation list used in digital signature validation.
CrlEntry describes a single entry in a certificate revocation list, including a revoked certificate's serial number.
DigestAlgorithm identifies the hash algorithm used to compute a message digest for digital signatures.
Document represents a PDF file loaded in memory, exposing pages, metadata, and save operations.
DocxFlowOptions controls how content from a DOCX file is reflowed into a PDF document.
DocxFlowResult reports the outcome of reflowing DOCX content into a PDF document.
EncryptOptions specifies how a PDF document is encrypted, including passwords, permissions, and algorithm.
ExportFormDataOptions configures the format and content of form data exported from a PDF document.
ExtractPagesOptions controls how a subset of pages is extracted from a PDF document.
FieldType enumerates the supported types of interactive form fields in a PDF document.
FlowParagraphOptions represents configuration settings for how a paragraph flows within its container.
FontOptimization specifies options for optimizing font embedding in the output document.
FormData holds data collected from interactive form fields in a PDF document.
G4EncodeOptions configures parameters for encoding images using the Group 4 compression algorithm.
Gradient defines a color transition used for filling shapes or text backgrounds.
HtmlComment represents an HTML comment node in the parsed document tree.
HtmlDoctype represents the HTML document type declaration node in the parsed document tree.
HtmlElement represents an HTML element node with tag name, attributes, and child nodes.
HtmlNode is the base type for all nodes in the HTML document tree.
HtmlText represents a text node containing literal text content in the HTML document tree.
IccTransformOptions specifies settings for applying ICC color profile transformations.
ImageOptions configures how images are processed and embedded during conversion or export.
ImportReport summarizes issues and metadata encountered when importing content.
InsertPagesOptions controls how pages are inserted from one document into another.
InvalidPasswordError is raised when an encrypted PDF cannot be opened due to an incorrect password.
LayoutAttributes holds properties that affect how content is arranged on a page.
LinearizationCheck reports whether a PDF file is linearized for fast web view.
ListAttributes defines styling and behavior options for list elements.
MakeSearchableOptions configures how text recognition is performed on scanned pages.
MakeSearchablePage represents the result of making a single page searchable.
MakeSearchableReport summarizes the outcome of making multiple pages searchable.
MdBlock represents a block-level Markdown node such as a paragraph or heading.
MdBlockQuote represents a Markdown blockquote node.
MdCode represents a Markdown code block node.
MdEmph represents an emphasized (italic) Markdown inline node.
MdHardBreak represents a hard line break in Markdown content.
MdHtmlInline represents an inline HTML element within Markdown content.
MdImage represents a Markdown image reference node.
MdInline is the base type for inline Markdown nodes.
MdItem represents a list item node in Markdown content.
MdNode is the base type for all nodes in the Markdown document tree.
MdParagraph represents a Markdown paragraph node.
MdSoftBreak represents a soft line break in Markdown content.
MdStrong represents a strongly emphasized (bold) Markdown inline node.
MdTableRow represents a row of cells in a Markdown table node.
MdText represents a plain text node in Markdown content.
MdThematicBreak represents a thematic break (horizontal rule) in Markdown content.
Metadata holds document properties such as title, author, and custom fields.
MetadataSyncReport summarizes changes made to document metadata during synchronization.
MetadataUpdate describes a single change to a document metadata property.
NUpOptions represents configuration settings for arranging multiple pages onto a single sheet when converting or printing PDF documents.
OcspResponse represents the response returned by an Online Certificate Status Protocol server for certificate revocation checking.
OcspSingleResponse represents a single certificate status response within an OCSP response.
OpenOptions specifies parameters used when opening a PDF document, such as password and load limits.
OptimizeReport provides details about optimization operations performed on a PDF document.
OverlayOptions defines settings for applying overlay content onto existing PDF pages.
PagePath represents a sequence of path segments that define a vector graphic path on a PDF page.
PageRenderingComparison holds the result of comparing the visual rendering of two PDF pages.
PageTextComparison holds the result of comparing the text content extracted from two PDF pages.
PathPaint describes how a path segment is rendered, including stroke and fill properties.
PathSegment represents a single drawing operation within a path, such as a line or curve.
PathSubpath groups a sequence of connected path segments forming a continuous subpath.
PdfParseError indicates that a file could not be parsed as a valid PDF document.
PdfUaConvertOptions specifies settings for converting a document to PDF/UA accessibility standard.
PdfXConvertOptions specifies settings for converting a document to PDF/X compliance standard.
Permissions defines the allowed and disallowed operations on a protected PDF document.
PrunePolicy determines which unused resources are removed during document optimization.
PubSecEncryptOptions specifies public key encryption settings for securing a PDF document.
PubSecRecipient represents a recipient of a publicly secured PDF document.
PubSecRecipientCert holds certificate information for a public key encryption recipient.
QrEcc specifies the error correction level used when generating a QR code.
QrOptions defines settings for generating a QR code within a PDF document.
RGB represents a color defined by red, green, and blue components.
RenderingCompareOptions specifies parameters used when comparing the visual rendering of two PDF pages.
RenderingComparison holds the result of comparing the visual rendering of two PDF pages.
ResizeOptions defines settings for changing the dimensions of PDF pages.
RevocationResult indicates the revocation status of a certificate obtained via OCSP or CRL.
SideBySideOptions specifies settings for comparing two PDF documents side by side.
SideBySideResult holds the outcome of a side-by-side comparison of two PDF documents.
SignOptions defines parameters for digitally signing a PDF document.
SignatureReport provides details about the digital signatures present in a PDF document.
SignatureScheme identifies the cryptographic algorithm used in a digital signature.
SkippedFont records information about a font that was not embedded or substituted during document processing.
SkippedFrame records information about a content frame that was not processed during document conversion.
SplitOptions defines parameters for splitting a PDF document into multiple files.
StampWithOptions specifies settings for applying a stamp to PDF pages.
StdFont represents one of the standard 14 fonts defined in the PDF specification.
SummarizeOptions defines parameters for generating a summary of a PDF document's text content.
SummarizeResult holds the generated summary of a PDF document's text content.
SvgOptions specifies settings for converting PDF pages to SVG format.
SyncDirection represents the direction of synchronization for table rows.
TabLeader specifies the character used to fill the space between tab stops and text in a table cell.
TableAttributes holds formatting properties for a table such as borders, padding, and alignment.
TableStitchOptions controls how table rows are split across pages when auto pagination is enabled.
TextBlockOptions defines formatting and layout settings for text blocks added to a page.
TextChange records a single text modification detected during comparison of two documents.
TextComparison performs text-level comparison between two PDF documents and reports differences.
TextComparisonStats summarizes the results of a text comparison operation with counts of changes.
TextFont describes the font used for text rendering including name, size, and style attributes.
TextLine represents a single line of text with its position, content, and formatting.
TiffEncodeOptions specifies encoding parameters when converting pages to TIFF format.
TimeStampRequestInfo holds information about a timestamp request for document signing.
TimeStampRequestOptions configures the parameters for requesting a timestamp from a timestamp authority.
TimeStampTokenOptions defines settings for embedding a timestamp token into a signed document.
TstInfo contains details about a timestamp token including the time, serial number, and authority.
UnsupportedFeatureError is raised when an operation attempts to use a feature not supported by the library.
XfaConvertOptions controls how XFA forms are processed during PDF conversion operations.
XfaConvertReport provides a summary of the conversion process for XFA forms including issues encountered.
XfaFieldResult reports the outcome of converting a single XFA form field.
XfaSkipped indicates an XFA form element that was not converted due to unsupported features.
XmpWriteOptions specifies how XMP metadata is written when saving a PDF document.
